name: ea-path-probe
title: ea-path-probe
author: Jake Mismas
description: Test-only path-request driver for T15e driver 2 (slice ridges): generates the chunks round given start and goal pairs, then sends surface.request_path for each pair a set number of times with a small biter's box and collision mask, counts the finished, failed and retried requests and the ticks they took, and writes script-output/ea-path-probe/<label>.json; the runner times the window with --benchmark-verbose all. Configured by startup settings the runner writes; it gets every position from the runner at run time. Never shipped.
